ai.overview: The Huskies have defended the belt twice in this reign and bring a four-game winning streak into the matchup, while Duke looks to claim the belt for the 29th time in program history after dropping their last contest to Illinois.
key_matchups: UConn's current four-game win streak against Duke's loss to Illinois by a 78-99 margin in their most recent outing
Duke holds a narrow 6-5 edge in the all-time series, including a tight 72-73 UConn win in their last meeting on March 29, 2026
These teams have met three times previously with the belt on the line, adding historical weight to this neutral-site showdown
ai.betting_angles: UConn enters with momentum, riding four straight wins including an 84-68 victory over Ohio State, while Duke is reeling from a lopsided 78-99 loss to Illinois. The Elo model calls this a toss-up despite UConn's 4-0 record and Duke's 3-2 mark. The all-time series is nearly even at 6-5 Duke, and their most recent meeting was decided by a single point.
ai.prediction_writeup: UConn's current form gives them the edge in what the Elo model projects as a toss-up. The Huskies have won four straight and appear sharper than a Duke team coming off a 78-99 drubbing at the hands of Illinois. While Duke holds a slight 6-5 advantage in the all-time series, UConn won the most recent meeting 73-72 in March 2026, showing they can win tight games against this opponent. The neutral site keeps this close, but UConn's momentum and belt-holder confidence should carry them through in a low-possession battle.
